Calendar support is a popular request from the community.

You can vote for the feature via the Mozilla Connect link below. https://connect.mozilla.org/t5/ideas/calendar-support-on-thunderbird-mobile/idi-p/76394

The team note in their state of the Thunder Blog ...

"For calendar explorations, we’ll determine whether it’s better to integrate with the native Android calendar or build a calendar section for the app."

Ref: https://blog.thunderbird.net/2025/12/state-of-the-thunder-14-the-2026-mobile-roadmap/
